# todo (Go)

A small in-memory todo API used as the Go brownfield target. Standard library only.

- `POST /todos` `{"title": "..."}` creates a todo. The title is trimmed and must be 1 to 200 characters; otherwise the response is `400 {"error": "..."}`. Bodies over 64 KiB are rejected.
- `GET /todos` lists them

Run tests with `go test ./...`.
